description: IAMAtlas v0.1 REBUILD - unified IAM cell-type methylation reference matrix, xz-compressed (LFS). 483,092 CpGs x 264 columns (32 class-level brightness + 230 per-cell-type [115 cells x 2] + n_classes_with_data). REPLACES the retired collapsed IAMAtlas.csv.xz (sha256 a11f62b0...). Rebuilt with iamatlas_v0_1_mcmc_batched_FIXED.py to fix the per-cell-type flatness in the original build. 8 architecture classes (immune=51, cycling=19, secretory=18, terminal=9, progenitor=11, stromal=5, stem_pluri=1, stem_adult=1) - cell counts reflect post-reconciliation cleanup that resolved Salas a-prefix duplicates and lowercase thin-twin duplicates. 450K-level CpG universe. Every class distinctness-tested before acceptance. Built 2026-05-28. Uncompressed ~577 MB.

Maps each of the 115 REBUILD cell types to its architecture class. Required by the deconvolver for class-level aggregation. Replaces IAMAtlas_celltype_to_class.json (which mapped 133 cells before duplicate reconciliation).

Full build metadata for the REBUILD edition: build date, pipeline steps (FIXED MCMC -> reconcile_duplicates -> merge -> compact), predecessor, the 8 classes, n_cell_types=115, n_cpgs=483092, frozen H_min values, per-class distinctness test outcomes.

READ BEFORE ANY REBUILD. The flatness problem and the fix: the original v0.1 build's per-cell-type layer collapsed onto the class mean despite clean R-hat convergence; the FIXED script's per-pair logit-mean parameterization restores distinct cells; the FIXED script produces high R-hat (1.4-2.6) and low ESS (5-9) with zero divergences, which is BENIGN for the means and must not be 'fixed' down. Replaces the prior MCMC_BUILD_LESSONS.md which incorrectly stated the 7 non-stromal v0.1 classes were 'valid as-is and not re-run' - they were collapsed and HAVE been re-run.

Points to IAMAtlas_FLATNESS_LESSON.md as the load-bearing 'read before any rebuild' document.

CANONICAL MCMC build script (USE FOR ALL FUTURE REBUILDS). Hierarchical Bayesian per-class model with the swamp+ridge fix: parameters restricted to observed (cpg,celltype) pairs; per-pair mu_logit prior removing the sigma_class_logit/log_kappa identifiability ridge. The older iamatlas_v0_1_mcmc_batched.py lacks this fix; the 7 non-stromal v0.1 classes were built with the old script and converged only because their data overpowered the ridge (verified: fixed model reproduces old at corr 0.99996). Stromal required this fix. See MCMC_BUILD_LESSONS.md.

Stage 3 of the REBUILD pipeline. Combines the 8 per-class outputs into the unified IAMAtlasREBUILD.csv. Reads the *.RECONCILED.csv files from reconcile_duplicates.py plus the original brightness.csv files. Writes IAMAtlasREBUILD.csv, IAMAtlasREBUILD_celltype_to_class.json, and IAMAtlasREBUILD_provenance.json. Replaces the older merge_iamatlas_v0_1.py.

Stage 2 of the REBUILD pipeline. Resolves duplicate-named cell types surfaced by the rebuild's distinctness tests. Immune: merges 12 a-prefix Salas-naming variants (aCD8Tmem vs CD8Tmem etc.) into their plain-name twins via coverage-weighted inverse-variance pooling (corr=1.000 between pairs confirmed they are the same biological cells). Cycling/Secretory/Terminal: drops thin lowercase variants (lung/hepatocyte/mammary/brain/heart/skeletal) whose better-covered capitalized twins exist; keeps thin no-twin cells (small_intestine, neuron) at low confidence per the two-tier design. Run between MCMC and merge.

L9 unified null-test framework v2 (2026-05-30). 8 standard nulls: N1 HC-label permutation, N2 age-strata permutation, N3 sex-strata permutation, N4 cohort-split replication, N5 plate-position null, N6 injection-recovery, N7 end-to-end simulation (now wired to synthetic_patient_generator.py — no longer DEFERRED), N8 look-elsewhere correction. Required for every CPG-VAL: N1, N4. Strongly recommended: N2, N6, N7, N8.

Phase A2 synthetic patient generator (2026-05-30). Methylome's FFP10/NPIPE equivalent. SyntheticCohort class generates β-matrix with known truth: per-patient cell-type fractions (Dirichlet), age, sex, batch, plate position, disease-panel CpG injection with hypomethylation-bias (5.4:1 matching CPG-VAL-003 empirical). ChainRecoveryTester reads cohort, runs simplified chain, returns recovery test (R3 Mahalanobis recovers signal). Wired into N7 of cpg_null_runner.py — N7 now performs real end-to-end sim instead of vacuous DEFERRED pass.

CPG-VAL-002 null suite run (2026-05-30). 7/7 declared nulls PASS at n_permutations=2000. N1 label perm p=0, N2 age-strata perm p=0, N3 sex-strata perm p=0, N4 cohort-split 100% concordance both cohorts, N6 injection-recovery within tolerance, N7 DEFERRED Phase A2, N8 skipped single-feature. First CPG-VAL formally null-validated.

CPG-VAL-002 null suite v2 (2026-05-30) with REAL N7 wired in. 7/7 PASS: N1 label perm p=0, N2 age-strata perm p=0, N3 sex-strata perm p=0, N4 cohort-split 100% concordance, N6 injection-recovery within tolerance, N7 synthetic cohort 47case/600HC at injected d=+2.0 recovers positive d through chain, N8 single-feature no correction needed.

CPG-VAL-002 per-sample reconstruction. 647 patients (47 cases / 600 HC after 1 NaN drop) × {gsm, arm, cohort, age, gender, mahalanobis_distance}. Mahalanobis built from HC pooled reference centroid, Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage 0.0090, 115-cell-type feature space. d=+1.876 GSE51057, +2.097 GSE51032.
Walther IAM Deconvolver documentation: design rationale, usage, two-tier class/cell-type output, validation status.

Walther IAM Deconvolver - cell-fraction estimator built for IAMAtlas. Two-tier: per-CLASS fractions (primary, reliable - the 8 architecture classes) + per-cell-type (secondary, indicative - within-class cells weakly separable in v0.1). Rank-based marker selection adapts to atlas's compressed between-cell variance; bounded-memory streaming (~120MB on full 1.2GB atlas). Replaces removed prototype iamatlas_deconvolver.py which used absolute thresholds that rejected all CpGs and loaded whole matrix. Validated: clean mixture recovered exactly, noisy 3-class class-level err ~0.10.

Stage 2 scoring module (NEW 2026-05-29 — TODO 1.1 v0.2 sharpening extension). Two functions: score_per_class(beta_dict, class_markers, H_min_by_class) returns 8 class A-scores; score_per_celltype(beta_dict, celltype_markers, celltype_to_class, H_min_by_class) returns 115 cell-type A-scores. Both return per-result A-score + coverage + confidence + status (OK / INSUFFICIENT_MARKERS / NO_MARKER_OVERLAP). Sibling to the Walther IAM Deconvolver, NOT a replacement: deconvolver does NNLS fractions, this module does entropy-at-markers A-scores. Different math, different CpG sets, different failure modes - kept independent for testability.

Built from IAMAtlasREBUILD (source SHA 41b7c16f...). Loaded by iamatlas_a_scoring.py at startup. Unlocks per-cell-type A-scores beyond the 8-class output: VAL-095 aTreg at >10yr breast pre-dx d=+1.26/+0.79 and VAL-096 pancreatic/kidney/erythrocyte-progenitor signals now natively in one pipeline run; new findings at sub-cellular resolution include Basophils d=+1.577 in GSE51057 and BE breast-epithelial d=+1.281 at >10yr.

Stage 4 runtime matrix. A-score thresholds for tier calls: NORMAL (A<=1.05), MARGINAL (1.05<A<=1.07), DETECTABLE (1.07<A<=1.10), URGENT (1.10<A), FLOOR_BREACH (A above class ceiling), BELOW_NORMAL (A significantly below age-matched expectation = suppression/homogenization). Includes engine -> customer language collapse: engine tiers map to ELEVATED / SIGNIFICANTLY_ELEVATED / SUPPRESSED / NORMAL in the customer report.

CPG (Cellular Performance Gauge) post-IAMAtlas-build Evidence Report v1 (2026-05-29). Reproducibility quadruple (cohort + script + sealed prereg + sealed results) mandatory for every VAL block. Family A (Section 3) = 7 foundation VALs CPG-VAL-001 through CPG-VAL-007 from the 2026-05-29 v0.2 sharpening session, full methodology + headline results + replication evidence + outcome codes. Family B (Section 4) = breast-epic template placeholders CPG-VAL-008 through CPG-VAL-014. CPG uses IAMAtlas-native tools ONLY — never external panels (Xu-538) or atlases (Loyfer/EpiSCORE/Salas/UniLIFE) in production scoring. Pre-build evidence archived in RETIRED_Evidence_Report.html.

CPG (Cellular Performance Gauge) post-build Complete VAL Inventory v1 (2026-05-29). 6-rule reproducibility protocol at top: every VAL row must have GSE+URL+paper+script+SHA+prereg+SHA+results+SHA+per-sample+SHA+outcome+headline+code. Four families: A=foundation confirmation (7 entries, all sealed pending VAL formalization), B=per-card confirmation (breast-epic template B.1, immune-epic B.2 pending), C=exploratory enrichment (future), D=educational replication (future).
